finding: V3 dual-plane routing materially improves synthetic recall/cost only when the secondary plane has materially distinct provenance; fully correlated missing-edge ancestry removes the recall gain. Route-mode hysteresis reduces chattering but increases modeled send cost substantially.
counterhypotheses: Actual repository topology may erase synthetic V3 gains
A cheap recompute may outperform hysteresis
A second projection with shared ancestry is redundant complexity, not fault tolerance
required_next: Real-repo matched V2/V3 replay with correlated/independent edge faults, ACK/drop/stale recovery, route-mode dwell/switch metrics and resource cost; keep V2 rollback.
